headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points while Nifty slipped below 25,350 amid broad sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian share markets are shut today, 24 November 2026, on account of Guru Nanak Jayanti.
In the last trading session, broad-based sell-off hit Dalal Street causing Sensex to crash 1,484 points.
Metal and PSU banking stocks faced severe selling pressure during the previous session.
Sensex crashed over 1,600 points from its day's high during Monday's trading.
whatHappening: Stock markets are closed for trading today due to an official NSE holiday.
On the last trading day, Sensex closed 1,484 points lower and Nifty ended below 25,350.
Investors lost over Rs 6 lakh crore in wealth during Monday's market crash.
IT sector outshined while metal and banking stocks were the worst hit in the last session.
summary: Markets are closed today, 24 November 2026, for Guru Nanak Jayanti and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November. On the last trading day, Dalal Street witnessed a major crash with the Sensex plunging 1,484 points and Nifty closing below 25,350. Investors lost over Rs 6 lakh crore as metal and banking stocks suffered heavy losses.
